def facts():
    (ast,) = asts(T(X) + T(Y))
    S.PLANS.pop(ast.key, None)
    renderer = TinyDevice["KTPU"].renderer
    prog = S.to_program(ast, renderer)
    sink, lin, source, binary = prog.src
    est = sink.arg.estimates
    params = [u for u in ast.toposort() if u.op is Ops.PARAM]
    return {
        "op": prog.op.name,
        "source": source.arg.split(" ")[:2],
        "binary": binary.arg == ast.key,
        "estimates": [est.ops, est.lds, est.mem],
        "params": len(lin.src) == len(params),
        "filed": S.PLANS[ast.key].kind,
    }
